en.headline: Five injured after taxi and three cars collide on Tsing Kwai Highway
en.dek: The four-vehicle pile-up near Lai King at 8:40 a.m. left four men and one woman with minor injuries; the Kowloon-bound fast lane was closed until 10:39 a.m.
body: Five people were injured when a taxi and three private cars collided on the Kowloon-bound carriageway of Tsing Kwai Highway near Lai King MTR station at about 8:40 a.m. on Monday.
Police said four men and one woman sustained minor injuries. The Fire Services Department said all five were taken to Princess Margaret Hospital in Kwai Chung for treatment.
The Transport Department said the fast lane of the Kowloon-bound Tsing Kwai Highway was temporarily closed because of the accident and reopened at 10:39 a.m.

zh.headline: 青葵公路的士與三車相撞 五人輕傷送院
zh.dek: 今早約8時40分近荔景往九龍方向發生四車相撞，四男一女輕傷，快線一度封閉至上午10時39分。
body: 周一早上約8時40分，一輛的士與三輛私家車在青葵公路往九龍方向近荔景港鐵站相撞，導致五人受傷。
警方表示四男一女傷勢輕微。消防處指五名傷者均被送往葵涌瑪嘉烈醫院治理。
運輸署表示，事故導致青葵公路往九龍方向快線一度封閉，至上午10時39分重開。
